done_when: The Board tab shows its summary line for every board that has active work, including one where every item is ready to merge or in planning, and the mounted Board-tab test covers both of those boards

known.title: Not done: test Board summaries in new and upgraded client repos

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The new mounted test mocks every `forge board` response with hand-built data. Its ready-only fixture contains two fixes but reports one ready part and one ready fix. It therefore does not verify that real board counts produce the summary in a new client repo or one adopted on an earlier release and upgraded. The existing installation test opens an empty repo and checks an old-version warning (`tests/test_mod_install.py:108,118`); it does not check the updated summary after upgrade. The repository's review rule requires coverage of both delivery paths.
findings.title: Not done: test Board summaries in new and upgraded client repos

why: The pane's Board tab opens with no summary line when the only active work is ready to merge or still in planning, so a person sees a bare list with no overview
